info.title: suno-api
info.description: Suno API Final runtime, including guarded direct-HTTP Studio adapters and a local CDP Transport bridge for an already loaded Studio page.

tags.name: Studio
tags.description: Fixed direct-HTTP Studio adapters plus the explicitly documented CDP Transport bridge. Paid and unverified writes are disabled by default.

post.description: The custom mode enables users to provide additional details about the music, such as music genre, lyrics, and more.2 audio files will be generated for each request, consuming a total of 10 credits.wait_audio can be set to API mode:• By default, it is set to false, which indicates the background mode. It will only return audio task information, and you will need to call the get API to retrieve detailed audio information.• If set to true, it simulates synchronous mode. The API will wait for a maximum of 100s until the audio is generated, and will directly return the audio link and other information. Recommend using in GPTs and other agents.

post.summary: Download Suno Studio Multitrack by studio_export clip ID
post.description: Pure HTTP by default. Resolves studio_project_id from authenticated clip metadata, fetches the exact Studio project state, calls render-state-multitrack, resumes the HTTP ZIP download when interrupted, validates every WAV header, writes SHA256 plus a manifest, and reuses a verified archive by clip ID unless force_redownload is explicit. Chrome/CDP is not required.

clip_id.description: Completed Suno clip whose type is studio_export

dry_run.description: Validate metadata and exact Studio project state without submitting a render

force_redownload.description: Intentionally submit a fresh Multitrack export instead of reusing a verified archive

200.description: Verified Studio Multitrack ZIP downloaded or reused

400.description: Invalid JSON, clip ID, or parameter

422.description: Clip is not a valid studio_export

502.description: Project mismatch, render, HTTP download, ZIP, or WAV validation failure

504.description: Project lookup, render, or download timeout

post.summary: Download Auto split stems by Suno song ID
post.description: Pure HTTP by default. Discovers an existing stem bank or submits one persisted gen_stem transaction, polls the returned clip IDs, renders WAV/MP3 through the Studio API, resumes interrupted HTTP downloads, validates the ZIP, and writes or repairs a manifest. A verified archive is reused by clip ID plus format. Chrome/CDP is not required; a cold Auto split can consume Suno credits.

Read the live Suno Studio playback position
get.description: Reads current playback state from an already logged-in and loaded Suno Studio page. The bridge prefers the current DSP v2 Context and falls back to the legacy playbackController. It is a local CDP bridge, not a Suno backend Transport endpoint.

503.description: CDP is unavailable, no Studio page is loaded, or neither the DSP v2 Context nor legacy playback controller is ready

post.summary: Play the loaded Suno Studio timeline
post.description: Starts playback from the current position and verifies that the timeline actually advances. It may use Studio's native Space-key Transport once to activate WebAudio.

200.description: Playback started or was already advancing

409.description: Studio accepted the Play state but the timeline did not advance

503.description: CDP, Studio page, or playback controller is unavailable

post.summary: Pause the loaded Suno Studio timeline
post.description: Pauses playback while preserving the current Beat position.

409.description: Studio did not enter the paused state

503.description: CDP, Studio page, or playback controller is unavailable

post.summary: Stop the loaded Suno Studio timeline and return to 0 seconds
post.description: Defines stable local Stop semantics as paused at project time 0. DSP v2 uses setPlaying(false) followed by seek(0); the legacy controller remains a fallback.

409.description: Studio did not remain stopped at 0 seconds

503.description: CDP, Studio page, or playback controller is unavailable

post.summary: Seek the loaded Suno Studio timeline by seconds or Beats
post.description: The JSON request must contain exactly one finite JSON number: seconds or beats. Seconds cannot be negative. When Studio is already playing, Seek preserves the prior playback state.

200.description: Playhead moved to the requested position

400.description: Missing, ambiguous, non-numeric, non-finite, or negative-seconds request

409.description: Studio did not reach the requested position

503.description: CDP, Studio page, or playback controller is unavailable
